_comment: AutoCRO ship/kill rules. Evaluated by analysis/evaluate.py after every traffic run.
rules: R1 Validity: if the sample-ratio-mismatch p-value < srm_p_threshold the test is INVALID — pause and investigate, never ship.
R2 Patience: no decision before every variant has min_exposed_per_variant exposed visitors. alpha is 0.01 (not 0.05) because results are checked after every traffic run (sequential peeking).
R3 Ship: primary metric uplift > min_relative_uplift, two-sided p < alpha AND probability-to-beat-control >= min_prob_to_beat.

R4 Guardrails: do not ship if any guardrail metric is worse with p < guardrail_harm_alpha, or its point estimate drops more than guardrail_max_relative_drop (sanity cap) — unless the primary metric IS that guardrail.
R5 Kill: stop if the primary metric is significantly worse (p < alpha), or max_exposed_per_variant is reached without a ship decision (inconclusive -> keep control: simplest wins).
R6 Isolation: at most max_concurrent_experiments running, and never two running experiments that change the same feature key or share an exposure page.
R7 Ship = merge the winning variant's features/css into site/config/site-config.json, log to docs/decision-log.md; the change becomes the new control.
_overrides: An experiment may set rule_overrides (e.g. a higher min_exposed_per_variant from a power calculation).
